verdict.rationale: The CLI docs show `lms load [--gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0] [--context-length=1-N]`, which covers both custom GPU offload and context length when loading a model from the command line. A further example shows `lms load` with a custom `--identifier`, and the headless llmster daemon supports command-line-only use. Missing for 10: deeper documentation of the flags' behavior beyond the synopsis line, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI load options.
